How many patch versions did the Claude Code CLI bundled inside the claude-agent-sdk Python package move forward between the release that added the SessionStore adapter and the release that added terminal_reason to ResultMessage?

The bundled Claude CLI moved from version 2.1.116 (SessionStore adapter) to 2.1.218 (terminal_reason on ResultMessage), a forward change of 218 − 116 = **21** patch versions.

Supporting source: https://github.com/anthropics/claude-agent-sdk-python/blob/v0.2.126/CHANGELOG.md
